In this special episode of The Ranveer Show, Dr. Vineet Aggarwal delves into the deeper significance of Ganesh Chaturthi, unraveling the fascinating creation story of Lord Ganesha. In this Podcast, we explore how Ganesha symbolizes the union of energy (Shakti) and consciousness (Shiva), making him the guardian of new beginnings and remover of obstacles.
